findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Our Covenant" above "A Day to Hold Close"; "The Wedding Of" above "Baseleal and Bethel"; "JAN" above "3"; "Save The Date" above "The Day of Our Vows"; "Celebration Details" above "Sunday"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 35 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Our Covenant", "The Wedding Of", "Request The Presence Of Your Company", "For Their Upcoming Wedding").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.pointer-events-none.absolute → linear-gradient(lab(96.7841 0.836074 4.00157 / 0.15) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%, lab(96.7841 0.836074 4.00157 /
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 13 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: article.relative.z-20 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | a.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.min-h-[46px].px-7 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 11 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.mt-8.pt-6 516px | section#countdown.reveal-seq.scroll-mt-24 1440px | div.pb-6.sm:pb-7 654px | div.pt-6.sm:pt-7 654px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 159px at 1440px. Widest offenders: img.w-full.h-full (+159px), div.w-full.flex (+128px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: The margins differ: 148px on the left, 177px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Baseleal & Bethel") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.
